messages:
Anya K: quick sync — opened a compact 'throttle playbook' PR that combines 429, timeout, and context-limit guidance into one page. draft here: https://rwd-internal/gh/pulls/42 (WIP).
Samir G: nice. can you call out the JS + Python retry snippets? those are what people search for.
Anya K: yup — added JS + py examples. kept them minimal: exponential backoff + capped jitter. example: ```js
await retry(async () => callRedwood(), {retries: 5, backoff: t => Math.min(1000 * 2**t, 5000)})
```
Liam H: small ask — add a short section on when to prefer client-side vs server-side throttling (and mention Dedicated vs Hosted behavior). many customers confuse where to catch 429s.
Anya K: good point. I'll add a 2-bullet decision matrix. also planning a tiny migration checklist for SDKs: update client to expose retry hooks, document default rate-limit headers to read.
Marisol V: for the Python snippet, can we show the Requests + tenacity pattern? e.g. ```py
@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(4), wait=wait_exponential(max=5))
def call():
    r = requests.post(url, json=payload)
    r.raise_for_status()
```
Trent P: thumbs-up. also include a note about trimming prompts when you hit context-limit-induced errors — show a sample heuristic: drop least-recent assistant turns first, then truncate oldest user messages.
Anya K: added that as 'context-trim fallback' section with pseudo-code. also flagged a couple of internal links that are broken — DocsBot, can you scan the page for stale anchors?
DocsBot: auto-link-scan complete — 2 broken anchors found: /docs/old-throttle and /sdk/js/retry-old. Suggested replacements included in the PR comments. :robot_face:
Samir G: can we also add a tiny test plan for QA: 1) simulate 429 by returning status, 2) simulate long response to exercise timeout fallback, 3) simulate KV cache hit to validate caching guidance. keep it checkbox style so reviewers can run fast.
Anya K: done — test checklist added to PR description. requesting review from @Liam @Marisol for content + @Trent for ops guidance.
Liam H: reviewing now, will leave inline comments on the Dedicated routing paragraph.
Marisol V: looks good overall; one nit about the tenacity import path. will send a quick patch.
Anya K: thanks team. plan to merge after fixes today. will post a small changelog blurb for the release notes (internal + public). :sparkles:
